title: Android Editor crash in ProgressDialog when saving scene (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.stable (Godot Editor on Google Play, crash report)
- Didn't check for reports in older versions

### System information

Android 14, Xiaomi Poco X5 Pro

### Issue description

This is a copy of a Google Play crash report for the Godot Editor on Android after it was updated to 4.6.stable yesterday.

We don't have more info than just the stacktrace, so we have to work from that.

Report for maintainers with access: https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/5310120689138741555/app/4972363226496209566/vitals/crashes/0fae656e6d864ac275d4f7eb4bc43281/details?days=28&isUserPerceived=true&versionCode=40600500
